Every team member must contribute meaningfully to the competition. Participants must respect fellow competitors, judges, mentors, volunteers, and organizers. Teams must submit their deliverables before the announced deadline. Late submissions may be penalized or disqualified. Participants must not attempt unauthorized access to systems, misuse personal data, or engage in unethical or illegal activities. All presentations must be professional, relevant to the assigned challenge, and completed within the allocated time. Participants must follow the venue's safety requirements and the organizers' instructions throughout the event. Any disputes, rule violations, or exceptional circumstances will be reviewed by the organizing committee. Deliverables Each team must submit the relevant deliverables for its assigned challenge, which may include: A working prototype, demonstration, campaign concept, sales pitch, or business solution. A short explanation of the problem and the proposed solution. A presentation outlining the approach, target audience, execution plan, and expected impact. Supporting materials such as designs, mock-ups, code, campaign creatives, or a business model, where applicable. Final Note MADLAB is an opportunity to move beyond ideas and demonstrate what you can create, communicate, build, market, and sell. Whether you are a developer, marketer, salesperson, designer, or business thinker, your skills have a place in the lab. Bring your creativity. Challenge the ordinary. Execute the extraordinary.
